reference_definition: Reviewed, QC-complete goals with resolved replay timing. Positive events require explicit offensive or mixed screen classification and a named offensive teammate. Negatives require explicit clear-sight or defensive-only classification. Within participant-bearing screen events, attribution is evaluated against the recorded participant set; its completeness is a reference-standard assumption. Screen-on-pass events and screen events without named offensive teammates are excluded.
regularization: Requested penalties below the fitted glmnet path minimum use its terminal coefficients.
